title: Workflow asset roots can be hijacked by repo-local or ambient env assets
description: resolveWorkflowAssetRoots prefers BOREAL_ASSET_ROOT and workspace-local workflows/templates/skills before bundled/source assets, and install/update repo consume that root. A project or inherited environment can replace installed agent skills/workflows without an explicit trust decision.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk install, update repo, and doctor skills default to bundled or trusted source assets unless an explicit trusted asset root is requested.
Repo-local workflows/templates/skills and BOREAL_ASSET_ROOT cannot silently override installed machine assets.
Regression tests prove malicious repo-local assets and ambient env assets are rejected or require an explicit unsafe/trusted opt-in.
